title: ClientConfig request_timeout=Duration::ZERO behavior is version-dependent and undocumented
description: client.rs JmapClient::new() accepts Duration::ZERO for request_timeout with comment 'some reqwest versions treat Duration::ZERO as no timeout'. Different reqwest versions differ: some treat zero as instant-timeout (every request fails immediately), others as no timeout. The comment names the ambiguity but does not document which version is installed or what behavior the code actually relies on. A dependency upgrade could silently flip all requests to instant-fail. Fix: either reject Duration::ZERO with an explicit error, or document the actual behavior of the pinned reqwest version and add a compile-time or test assertion.
